comment: 60yo postmenopausal female (LMP age 51), dietary calcium intake ~550 mg/day (below IOM RDA 1200 mg/day for age >50), serum 25-OH-vitamin-D 22 nmol/L (below IOM <30 nmol/L deficiency threshold). Co-existing osteopenia on most recent DEXA (T-score -1.8 lumbar spine). No current cancer diagnosis. WCRF/AICR Continuous Update Project rates dietary calcium as 'probable' protective for colorectal cancer (RR ~0.92 per 300 mg/day). Vitamin D status associated with CRC risk in observational cohorts (~30% incidence reduction highest vs lowest quartile per IARC pooled analysis); causal RCT mixed (VITAL, ViDA) but signal for CRC-mortality reduction. Combined deficiency compounds risk; concurrent osteoporosis-prevention overlap. Engine fires RF-LIFESTYLE-LOW-CALCIUM-VIT-D-CRC-PREVENTION (all_of: dietary_calcium_intake_lt_800mg_per_day:true AND serum_25oh_vitamin_d_lt_30nmol_per_l:true) and routes to PreventionPlan: standard = dietary counseling + vitamin D repletion (cholecalciferol 1000-2000 IU/day target serum 25-OH-D ≥50 nmol/L) + calcium intake to RDA + USPSTF CRC screening per cadence + DEXA osteoporosis follow-up; alternative = USPSTF screening + dietary counseling without pharmacologic dosing. Validates v0.3 diet pilot.
